item.title: Course Flyover: TPC Toronto Hoot Course
item.description: Doug Carrick’s tribute to Pine Valley, the Hoot Course at TPC Toronto at Osprey Valley, is tremendous fun, with 18 isolated holes running through tall pines and navigating rugged waste bunkers. Smartly, Carrick’s routing offers just as many breather holes as beasts, one often following the other. It ranks No. 44 on our Top 100 and No. 17 on our Top 59 public courses list.
